# VRS RealInvest

> VRS RealInvest Pty Ltd is an Australian buyer's agency and real estate investment coaching business led by founder Sudhesh K Valappil. It represents buyers only (it does not sell property) and helps busy professionals buy low-risk, high-growth investment property anywhere in Australia, with end-to-end guidance from strategy to settlement.

## Key facts

- Business: Buyer's agent (buyer representation) and property investment coaching
- Legal name: VRS RealInvest Pty Ltd
- Founder: Sudhesh K Valappil
- Website: https://www.vrsrealinvest.com.au
- Phone: +61 412 864 050
- Email: sudhesh@vrsrealinvest.com.au
- Based in: New South Wales (NSW), Australia
- Service area: Australia-wide — NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS and NT
- Experience: 10+ years; 70+ investment properties secured for clients; 100+ free investor webinars run
- Who it helps: busy professionals (medical, IT, engineering, business owners), first-time investors, home owners building a portfolio, and families seeking passive income
- Services: strategy sessions based on goals and borrowing capacity; data-led suburb and property research; shortlisting; risk, rental demand and growth-driver checks; negotiation and contract review support; ongoing portfolio guidance
- Investment approach: low-risk suburbs with strong owner-occupier demand, strong rental fundamentals and tight vacancy rates, growth backed by infrastructure and supply-demand data, strategy-matched properties rather than hype
- 10-step process: understanding requirements → formalising the agreement → budget confirmation and loan pre-approval → research and due diligence → suburb presentation → property sourcing → negotiation and contract review → building and pest inspection → contingency management → settlement and handover
- Note: blog content is general information, not financial, tax or legal advice
